title: Principles of Chemistry I

rules.notes: Grade: 40% MindTap homework, 10% Thursday sessions, 30% three midterms, 20% final. Exams are online multiple choice with an SAT-approved calculator and the online Fact Sheet.

notes: Taught out of book order: chapters 1–4, then 10, 5, 6, then 7–9, then 11. Unit titles for chapters 1–6 and 10 are inferred from the syllabus learning outcomes; check them against MindTap.

units.title: Ch. 1 · Measurement, units and significant figures
Ch. 2 · Atoms, ions and naming compounds
Ch. 3 · The mole, formulas and stoichiometry
Ch. 4 · Reactions in solution (precipitation, acid–base, redox)
Ch. 6 · Quantum theory and electronic structure
Ch. 7 · Atomic electron configurations and periodic trends
Ch. 9 · Valence bond theory and molecular orbital theory
